description:
Audit adoption before a rollout or when checking whether the workspace is using memory and reporting outcomes. Takes no arguments. Returns JSON with memory-bank breakdowns, learning-loop activity, proof points and a benchmark checklist.

Does not change knowledge or run a benchmark. Use engram_setup for onboarding and engram_recall for task knowledge. Consumes workspace daily call quota. OAuth: memory:read.
name: engram_proof

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Get Engram Proof
